questions.question_text: A branch firewall must isolate a payment VLAN. Which FIRST change best limits traffic while preserving the documented HTTPS dependency?

options.A: Allow only the payment application subnet to the required HTTPS destination
options.B: Allow any internal host to every port
options.C: Disable the firewall during testing
options.D: Permit all Internet traffic to the VLAN

questions.explanation: This applies least privilege to source, destination, and service.

option_explanations.A: This applies least privilege to source, destination, and service.
option_explanations.B: This leaves the VLAN broadly reachable.
option_explanations.C: Disabling the control does not isolate the VLAN.
option_explanations.D: This expands rather than limits exposure.

zh-Hant.question_text: 分支防火牆必須隔離付款 VLAN。為保留已文件化的 HTTPS 相依性，哪項首先變更最能限制流量？

options.A: 只允許付款應用程式子網路連到必要 HTTPS 目的地
options.B: 允許所有內部主機連到所有連接埠
options.C: 測試期間停用防火牆
options.D: 允許所有 Internet 流量進入 VLAN

zh-Hant.explanation: 這將最小權限套用到來源、目的地與服務。

option_explanations.A: 這將最小權限套用到來源、目的地與服務。
option_explanations.B: 這會讓 VLAN 維持廣泛可達。
option_explanations.C: 停用控制無法隔離 VLAN。
option_explanations.D: 這會擴大而非限制暴露面。

questions.question_text: A contractor needs SSH access to one jump host for two hours. Which control BEST enforces the stated limit?

options.A: A permanent any-to-any allow rule
options.B: A DNS alias for the jump host
options.C: A longer password expiration period
options.D: A time-bound ACL scoped to the contractor source and jump-host port

questions.explanation: The rule limits identity context, source, destination, and duration.

option_explanations.A: It provides no scope or duration constraint.
option_explanations.B: A name alias does not enforce network access.
option_explanations.C: Password lifetime does not grant scoped network access.
option_explanations.D: The rule limits identity context, source, destination, and duration.

zh-Hant.question_text: 承包商需要兩小時 SSH 存取一台跳板機。哪項控制最能執行這項限制？

options.A: 永久 any-to-any allow 規則
options.B: 跳板機的 DNS 別名
options.C: 延長密碼到期期間
options.D: 依承包商來源與跳板機連接埠設定限時 ACL

zh-Hant.explanation: 此規則限制身分情境、來源、目的地與時間。

option_explanations.A: 它沒有範圍或時間限制。
option_explanations.B: 名稱別名不會執行網路存取控制。
option_explanations.C: 密碼壽命不會授予範圍化網路存取。
option_explanations.D: 此規則限制身分情境、來源、目的地與時間。

questions.question_text: A firewall rule set uses first-match logic. Which change should an analyst make FIRST after finding an any-to-any allow above a database deny?

options.A: Rename the database object
options.B: Disable logging for the allow rule
options.C: Move the specific database deny before the broad allow and test the resulting path
options.D: Add another deny below the existing allow

questions.explanation: The specific rule must be evaluated before the broad match.

option_explanations.A: Renaming does not change rule order.
option_explanations.B: Logging does not change enforcement.
option_explanations.C: The specific rule must be evaluated before the broad match.
option_explanations.D: First-match processing still reaches the earlier allow first.

zh-Hant.question_text: 防火牆規則採 first-match。分析師發現 any-to-any allow 在資料庫 deny 之前，應首先做哪項變更？

options.A: 重新命名資料庫物件
options.B: 停用 allow 規則的記錄
options.C: 將特定資料庫 deny 移到廣泛 allow 前並測試流量路徑
options.D: 在現有 allow 下方再加 deny

zh-Hant.explanation: 特定規則必須先於廣泛匹配被評估。

option_explanations.A: 重新命名不會改變規則順序。
option_explanations.B: 記錄設定不會改變執行結果。
option_explanations.C: 特定規則必須先於廣泛匹配被評估。
option_explanations.D: first-match 仍會先命中前面的 allow。

questions.question_text: A departing employee still has a valid SSO session on a managed laptop. What is the FIRST IAM action?

options.A: Keep the SSO session active until the password expires
options.B: Disable the identity and revoke active sessions through the IdP
options.C: Delete the laptop inventory record
options.D: Change only the laptop local password

questions.explanation: Disabling the identity and revoking sessions removes current access.

option_explanations.A: An active session can continue access after departure.
option_explanations.B: Disabling the identity and revoking sessions removes current access.
option_explanations.C: Inventory removal does not revoke an identity or its sessions.
option_explanations.D: A local password change does not revoke an existing cloud SSO session at the IdP.

zh-Hant.question_text: 離職員工在受管筆電上仍有有效 SSO session。首先 IAM 行動是什麼？

options.A: 讓 SSO session 維持到密碼到期
options.B: 停用身分並透過 IdP 撤銷有效 session
options.C: 刪除筆電資產清冊記錄
options.D: 只變更筆電本機密碼

zh-Hant.explanation: 停用身分並撤銷 session 可移除目前存取。

option_explanations.A: 離職後有效 session 可能繼續提供存取。
option_explanations.B: 停用身分並撤銷 session 可移除目前存取。
option_explanations.C: 移除資產清冊不會撤銷身分或 session。
option_explanations.D: 本機密碼變更並不在 IdP 撤銷既有雲端 SSO 工作階段。

questions.question_text: A policy engine evaluates device health and user context before access. Which Zero Trust principle does this illustrate?

options.A: Make an access decision using explicit, continuously evaluated context
options.B: Trust every internal address by default
options.C: Grant access permanently after one login
options.D: Use a shared administrator identity

questions.explanation: The decision is based on context rather than network location alone.

option_explanations.A: The decision is based on context rather than network location alone.
option_explanations.B: This contradicts continuous verification.
option_explanations.C: Permanent trust violates the stated principle.
option_explanations.D: A shared identity removes accountable context.

zh-Hant.question_text: Policy engine 在存取前評估裝置健康狀態與使用者情境。這說明哪個 Zero Trust 原則？

options.A: 使用明確且持續評估的情境作成存取決策
options.B: 預設信任所有內部位址
options.C: 一次登入後永久授予存取
options.D: 使用共用管理員身分

zh-Hant.explanation: 決策根據情境，而非只根據網路位置。

option_explanations.A: 決策根據情境，而非只根據網路位置。
option_explanations.B: 這與持續驗證相矛盾。
option_explanations.C: 永久信任違反題述原則。
option_explanations.D: 共用身分會移除可追蹤情境。

references.title: NIST SP 800-207 — Zero Trust Architecture
references.section: Zero Trust tenets and access decisions

questions.question_text: A production certificate rotation may break three clients that pin the current issuer. Which evidence should the CAB require before approval?

options.A: A successful scan of the certificate file for malware
options.B: The issuing CA public marketing statement alone
options.C: A certificate-expiration report with no client testing
options.D: Compatibility test results for each client and a tested backout plan

questions.explanation: Testing the affected dependencies and recovery steps addresses the specific change risk.

option_explanations.A: A clean file does not demonstrate client trust-chain compatibility or a recovery path.
option_explanations.B: The statement does not test the specific pinned clients or support rollback.
option_explanations.C: Expiration status does not establish compatibility with a newly pinned issuer.
option_explanations.D: Testing the affected dependencies and recovery steps addresses the specific change risk.

zh-Hant.question_text: 正式環境憑證輪替可能影響三個釘選現有發行者的用戶端。CAB 核准前應要求哪種證據？

options.A: 憑證檔案惡意軟體掃描成功
options.B: 僅發行 CA 的公開行銷聲明
options.C: 没有用戶端測試的憑證到期報告
options.D: 每個用戶端的相容測試結果與經測試的回復計畫

zh-Hant.explanation: 測試受影響相依性與復原步驟，可處理特定變更風險。

option_explanations.A: 檔案未含惡意軟體不能證明用戶端信任鏈相容或復原路徑。
option_explanations.B: 聲明沒有測試特定釘選用戶端，也不支持回復。
option_explanations.C: 到期狀態無法證明與新釘選發行者相容。
option_explanations.D: 測試受影響相依性與復原步驟，可處理特定變更風險。

questions.question_text: An endpoint sends DNS queries to a rare domain every 60 seconds and then uploads small encrypted bursts. What indicator should the analyst prioritize?

options.A: A one-time software-update download verified against an approved manifest
options.B: Only a DNS TTL expiry causing a cache refresh
options.C: Periodic beaconing followed by possible command-and-control transfer
options.D: A normal DHCP lease renewal

questions.explanation: The timing and follow-on encrypted bursts form a correlated indicator.

option_explanations.A: A verified one-time download does not match rare-domain periodic callbacks followed by repeated uploads.
option_explanations.B: TTL refresh may explain DNS timing alone but not the related outbound bursts to a rare destination.
option_explanations.C: The timing and follow-on encrypted bursts form a correlated indicator.
option_explanations.D: DHCP renewal does not explain periodic rare-domain callbacks.

zh-Hant.question_text: 端點每 60 秒向罕見網域發出 DNS 查詢，接著上傳小段加密流量。分析師應優先處理哪個指標？

options.A: 依核准清單驗證的一次性軟體更新下載
options.B: 僅 DNS TTL 到期造成快取更新
options.C: 週期性 beaconing 後疑似命令與控制傳輸
options.D: 正常 DHCP 租約更新

zh-Hant.explanation: 時間規律與後續加密流量構成關聯指標。

option_explanations.A: 經驗證的一次性下載不符合罕見網域定時回連並重複上傳的模式。
option_explanations.B: TTL 更新可能解釋 DNS 時序，但不能解釋向罕見目的地發送相關突發流量。
option_explanations.C: 時間規律與後續加密流量構成關聯指標。
option_explanations.D: DHCP 更新無法解釋週期性罕見網域回呼。

questions.question_text: A SIEM shows 400 failed logins across 120 accounts from one ASN, followed by one success. Which FIRST action is most appropriate?

options.A: Delete the ASN from the SIEM
options.B: Contain the source pattern and investigate the successful account for password spraying
options.C: Reset every employee’s password without preserving logs
options.D: Ignore the event because one login succeeded

questions.explanation: The broad failures and one success warrant containment and account investigation.

option_explanations.A: Deleting telemetry prevents investigation.
option_explanations.B: The broad failures and one success warrant containment and account investigation.
option_explanations.C: This destroys context and exceeds the observed scope.
option_explanations.D: A success after distributed failures may confirm compromise.

zh-Hant.question_text: SIEM 顯示來自同一 ASN 對 120 個帳號的 400 次失敗登入，之後成功一次。首先應採取什麼行動？

options.A: 從 SIEM 刪除 ASN
options.B: 遏止來源模式並調查成功登入的帳號是否遭 password spraying
options.C: 不保留記錄而重設所有員工密碼
options.D: 因一次成功登入而忽略事件

zh-Hant.explanation: 大量失敗與一次成功需要遏止並調查帳號。

option_explanations.A: 刪除遙測資料會阻礙調查。
option_explanations.B: 大量失敗與一次成功需要遏止並調查帳號。
option_explanations.C: 這會破壞情境並超出觀察範圍。
option_explanations.D: 分散失敗後的成功可能確認入侵。

questions.question_text: A web server exposes an obsolete admin port to the Internet. Which mitigation MOST directly reduces exploitability while a replacement is scheduled?

options.A: Restrict the port to the management subnet and require the jump host
options.B: Rename the port in documentation
options.C: Increase the session timeout on the administration service
options.D: Publish the port in a public inventory

questions.explanation: Reducing reachable sources and adding a controlled path lowers exposure.

option_explanations.A: Reducing reachable sources and adding a controlled path lowers exposure.
option_explanations.B: Documentation does not change network reachability.
option_explanations.C: Longer sessions do not reduce which sources can reach the obsolete service.
option_explanations.D: Public disclosure increases attacker information.

zh-Hant.question_text: Web server 將過時管理連接埠暴露於 Internet。替代系統排程中，哪項 mitigation 最直接降低可利用性？

options.A: 將連接埠限制至管理子網路並要求經跳板機
options.B: 在文件中重新命名連接埠
options.C: 增加管理服務的工作階段逾時
options.D: 在公開清冊公布連接埠

zh-Hant.explanation: 減少可達來源並加入受控路徑可降低暴露。

option_explanations.A: 減少可達來源並加入受控路徑可降低暴露。
option_explanations.B: 文件不會改變網路可達性。
option_explanations.C: 延長工作階段不會減少可到達過時服務的來源。
option_explanations.D: 公開資訊會增加攻擊者情報。

questions.question_text: A compromised host is isolated, but the team needs RAM contents before shutdown. Which FIRST forensic action is appropriate?

options.A: Reboot immediately to clear malware
options.B: Edit the disk image before acquiring RAM
options.C: Publish the host image to the incident channel
options.D: Acquire volatile memory using an approved tool and document chain of custody

questions.explanation: Memory may disappear at shutdown, so acquisition and custody records come first.

option_explanations.A: Rebooting destroys volatile evidence.
option_explanations.B: Editing evidence before acquisition breaks integrity.
option_explanations.C: Public distribution risks evidence and sensitive data.
option_explanations.D: Memory may disappear at shutdown, so acquisition and custody records come first.

zh-Hant.question_text: 受害主機已隔離，但團隊需要關機前的 RAM 內容。首先應採取哪項鑑識行動？

options.A: 立即重新開機清除惡意程式
options.B: 先編輯磁碟映像再擷取 RAM
options.C: 將主機映像公布到事件頻道
options.D: 使用核准工具擷取易失記憶體並記錄 chain of custody

zh-Hant.explanation: 記憶體可能在關機時消失，因此先擷取並記錄保管鏈。

option_explanations.A: 重新開機會破壞易失證據。
option_explanations.B: 在擷取前編輯證據會破壞完整性。
option_explanations.C: 公開散布會危及證據與敏感資料。
option_explanations.D: 記憶體可能在關機時消失，因此先擷取並記錄保管鏈。

references.title: NIST SP 800-86 — Integrating Forensic Techniques into Incident Response
references.section: Data collection, integrity, and evidence handling

questions.question_text: A packet capture shows repeated outbound TLS connections, while firewall logs show only allowed destinations. Which additional source BEST identifies the process creating the connections?

options.A: A DNS query log showing the destination domain only
options.B: A firewall flow record without endpoint process data
options.C: Endpoint process telemetry correlated by timestamp and destination
options.D: A physical-access badge report

questions.explanation: Endpoint telemetry can map the connection to a process and user.

option_explanations.A: A domain alone does not identify the process creating the TLS session.
option_explanations.B: Flow metadata lacks the local process identity.
option_explanations.C: Endpoint telemetry can map the connection to a process and user.
option_explanations.D: Physical access does not identify the network process.

zh-Hant.question_text: 封包擷取顯示反覆對外 TLS 連線，而防火牆只記錄允許的目的地。哪項額外資料最能找出建立連線的程序？

options.A: 只顯示目的網域的 DNS 查詢日誌
options.B: 沒有端點程序資料的防火牆 flow record
options.C: 依時間戳與目的地關聯的端點程序遙測
options.D: 實體門禁卡報告

zh-Hant.explanation: 端點遙測可將連線對應到程序與使用者。

option_explanations.A: 只有網域無法識別建立 TLS session 的程序。
option_explanations.B: Flow metadata 缺少本機程序身分。
option_explanations.C: 端點遙測可將連線對應到程序與使用者。
option_explanations.D: 實體進出無法識別網路程序。

questions.question_text: A firewall records an outbound session to 203.0.113.9 at 02:14. An endpoint reports a suspicious process near that time. Which firewall fields BEST allow the analyst to link the events?

options.A: The destination domain alone
options.B: Source and destination addresses, ports, and timestamp
options.C: The firewall appliance asset owner
options.D: The password policy applied to administrators

questions.explanation: The session tuple and time connect the network event to matching endpoint connection telemetry.

option_explanations.A: A domain alone cannot identify the source host or align the specific session in time.
option_explanations.B: The session tuple and time connect the network event to matching endpoint connection telemetry.
option_explanations.C: Ownership information identifies accountability, not the host and session responsible for this connection.
option_explanations.D: A password policy gives authentication requirements rather than evidence of this outbound session.

zh-Hant.question_text: 防火牆在 02:14 記錄連向 203.0.113.9 的工作階段，端點在相近時間回報可疑程序。哪些防火牆欄位最適合關聯這些事件？

options.A: 僅目的網域
options.B: 來源與目的位址、埠號及時間戳
options.C: 防火牆設備的資產負責人
options.D: 套用於管理員的密碼政策

zh-Hant.explanation: 連線組合及時間可將網路事件連至相符端點連線遙測。

option_explanations.A: 僅網域無法識別來源主機，也不能按時間對齊特定連線。
option_explanations.B: 連線組合及時間可將網路事件連至相符端點連線遙測。
option_explanations.C: 負責人資訊識別責任，並不識別發起此連線的主機與工作階段。
option_explanations.D: 密碼政策描述驗證要求，並非此對外連線的證據。

questions.question_text: A store uses a door alarm and a board-approved access policy. Which TWO control categories are represented by those two measures? Select two.

options.A: A door alarm
options.B: An acceptable-use policy
options.C: A firewall ACL
options.D: A database trigger

questions.explanation: It is a physical control that detects entry conditions. It is a managerial control defining required behavior.

option_explanations.A: It is a physical control that detects entry conditions.
option_explanations.B: It is a managerial control defining required behavior.
option_explanations.C: It is a technical network control.
option_explanations.D: It is a technical application control.

zh-Hant.question_text: 商店使用門禁警報與董事會核准的存取政策。這兩種措施代表哪些控制類別？選兩項。

options.A: 門禁警報
options.B: 可接受使用政策
options.C: 防火牆 ACL
options.D: 資料庫 trigger

zh-Hant.explanation: 它是偵測進入狀態的實體控制。 它是定義行為要求的管理控制。

option_explanations.A: 它是偵測進入狀態的實體控制。
option_explanations.B: 它是定義行為要求的管理控制。
option_explanations.C: 它是技術網路控制。
option_explanations.D: 它是技術應用控制。

questions.question_text: A backup is readable only by authorized staff but contains a tampered record. Which CIA property remains protected and which is lost?

options.A: Availability remains; confidentiality is lost
options.B: Integrity remains; availability is lost
options.C: Non-repudiation remains; safety is lost
options.D: Confidentiality remains; integrity is lost

questions.explanation: Access remains restricted while content trust is broken.

option_explanations.A: No unauthorized disclosure is described.
option_explanations.B: The record was changed, and the backup remains readable.
option_explanations.C: These are not the CIA properties at issue.
option_explanations.D: Access remains restricted while content trust is broken.

zh-Hant.question_text: 備份只有授權員工可讀，但其中一筆記錄遭竄改。哪項 CIA 屬性仍受保護，哪項遺失？

options.A: 可用性仍在；機密性遺失
options.B: 完整性仍在；可用性遺失
options.C: 不可否認性仍在；安全性遺失
options.D: 機密性仍在；完整性遺失

zh-Hant.explanation: 存取仍受限，但內容可信度被破壞。

option_explanations.A: 題目沒有描述未授權揭露。
option_explanations.B: 記錄被修改，而備份仍可讀。
option_explanations.C: 這些不是題目涉及的 CIA 屬性。
option_explanations.D: 存取仍受限，但內容可信度被破壞。

questions.question_text: An employee receives a voice message directing her to disclose a one-time password to “IT.” Which vector is this?

options.A: Watering hole
options.B: Typosquatting
options.C: Vishing
options.D: Smishing

questions.explanation: Voice-based phishing is vishing.

option_explanations.A: A watering hole compromises a site visited by targets.
option_explanations.B: Typosquatting uses look-alike domain names.
option_explanations.C: Voice-based phishing is vishing.
option_explanations.D: Smishing uses text messages.

zh-Hant.question_text: 員工收到語音訊息，要求將一次性密碼提供給「IT」。這是哪種攻擊途徑？

options.A: Watering hole
options.B: Typosquatting
options.C: Vishing
options.D: Smishing

zh-Hant.explanation: 以語音進行的 phishing 是 vishing。

option_explanations.A: watering hole 會入侵目標常訪網站。
option_explanations.B: typosquatting 使用相似網域名稱。
option_explanations.C: 以語音進行的 phishing 是 vishing。
option_explanations.D: Smishing 使用文字訊息。

questions.question_text: A process accepts a filename and executes it with shell metacharacters intact. Which vulnerability should be addressed first?

options.A: Data remanence
options.B: Command injection
options.C: TOCTOU
options.D: Buffer overflow

questions.explanation: Untrusted input can alter the command interpreted by the shell.

option_explanations.A: The issue is command interpretation, not residual media data.
option_explanations.B: Untrusted input can alter the command interpreted by the shell.
option_explanations.C: No check-and-use race is described.
option_explanations.D: No memory-boundary overwrite is described.

zh-Hant.question_text: 程序接受檔名並保留 shell metacharacters 後執行。應首先處理哪種弱點？

options.A: Data remanence
options.B: Command injection
options.C: TOCTOU
options.D: Buffer overflow

zh-Hant.explanation: 不可信輸入可能改變 shell 解讀的命令。

option_explanations.A: 問題是命令解讀而非媒體殘留資料。
option_explanations.B: 不可信輸入可能改變 shell 解讀的命令。
option_explanations.C: 沒有描述檢查與使用之間的競態。
option_explanations.D: 沒有描述記憶體邊界覆寫。

questions.question_text: A web account receives reset requests from many countries, followed by a successful reset from one address. Which log evidence should be correlated FIRST?

options.A: Identity, source IP, timestamp, and reset result
options.B: DNS query logs for the reset service
options.C: Endpoint process creation logs
options.D: Asset purchase invoices

questions.explanation: These fields reveal the distributed reset pattern and successful event.

option_explanations.A: These fields reveal the distributed reset pattern and successful event.
option_explanations.B: DNS may provide context but does not establish account-reset results.
option_explanations.C: Process logs can show the client activity behind a reset request but are secondary to identity records.
option_explanations.D: Invoices do not provide authentication evidence.

zh-Hant.question_text: Web 帳號收到多國密碼重設要求，之後某位址成功重設。應首先關聯哪項記錄證據？

options.A: 身分、來源 IP、時間戳與重設結果
options.B: 重設服務的 DNS 查詢 logs
options.C: 端點程序建立記錄
options.D: 資產採購發票

zh-Hant.explanation: 這些欄位可揭示分散重設模式與成功事件。

option_explanations.A: 這些欄位可揭示分散重設模式與成功事件。
option_explanations.B: DNS 可提供情境但不能建立帳號重設結果。
option_explanations.C: 程序記錄可顯示重設請求背後的用戶端活動，但次於身分記錄。
option_explanations.D: 發票不提供驗證證據。

questions.question_text: A public API has no rate limit and exposes a costly search endpoint. Which mitigation BEST reduces abuse without removing the business function?

options.A: Publish the endpoint URL in more documentation
options.B: Disable all API logging
options.C: Allow unlimited anonymous requests
options.D: Require authentication and apply per-client rate limits

questions.explanation: Identity and throttling constrain abuse while preserving the API.

option_explanations.A: More exposure increases discovery.
option_explanations.B: Removing logs reduces investigation capability.
option_explanations.C: This preserves the abuse condition.
option_explanations.D: Identity and throttling constrain abuse while preserving the API.

zh-Hant.question_text: 公開 API 沒有 rate limit 且暴露高成本搜尋端點。哪項 mitigation 最能降低濫用而不移除業務功能？

options.A: 在更多文件公布端點 URL
options.B: 停用所有 API 記錄
options.C: 允許無限匿名請求
options.D: 要求驗證並套用每個用戶端的 rate limit

zh-Hant.explanation: 身分驗證與節流可限制濫用並保留 API。

option_explanations.A: 更多暴露會增加被發現機會。
option_explanations.B: 移除記錄會降低調查能力。
option_explanations.C: 這會保留濫用條件。
option_explanations.D: 身分驗證與節流可限制濫用並保留 API。

questions.question_text: A company places public web servers in a separate zone and keeps databases behind an internal firewall. Which architecture principle is demonstrated?

options.A: Shared administrative identity
options.B: Unrestricted east-west traffic
options.C: Network segmentation
options.D: Single flat network

questions.explanation: Separate trust zones limit lateral movement.

option_explanations.A: Identity sharing is unrelated to zone separation.
option_explanations.B: Unrestricted internal traffic defeats segmentation.
option_explanations.C: Separate trust zones limit lateral movement.
option_explanations.D: A flat network removes the described boundary.

zh-Hant.question_text: 公司將公開 web server 放在分離區域，資料庫則在內部防火牆後。這展現哪個架構原則？

options.A: 共用管理身分
options.B: 不受限 east-west 流量
options.C: 網路 segmentation
options.D: 單一平面網路

zh-Hant.explanation: 分離信任區可限制橫向移動。

option_explanations.A: 共用身分與區域分隔無關。
option_explanations.B: 不受限內部流量會破壞 segmentation。
option_explanations.C: 分離信任區可限制橫向移動。
option_explanations.D: 平面網路移除題述邊界。

questions.question_text: A cloud database must accept traffic only from an application subnet and a monitored administrative jump host. Which rule is BEST?

options.A: Allow only the database hostname
options.B: Allow only those sources and required database ports
options.C: Allow the entire cloud VPC to every port
options.D: Allow any Internet address with TLS

questions.explanation: The rule applies least privilege to source and service.

option_explanations.A: A name alone is not an access rule.
option_explanations.B: The rule applies least privilege to source and service.
option_explanations.C: This is broader than the requirement.
option_explanations.D: Encryption does not limit who may connect.

zh-Hant.question_text: 雲端資料庫只能接受應用程式子網路與受監控管理跳板機流量。哪項規則最適合？

options.A: 只允許資料庫 hostname
options.B: 只允許這些來源與必要資料庫連接埠
options.C: 允許整個 cloud VPC 使用所有連接埠
options.D: 允許所有 Internet 位址搭配 TLS

zh-Hant.explanation: 規則將最小權限套用到來源與服務。

option_explanations.A: 名稱本身不是存取規則。
option_explanations.B: 規則將最小權限套用到來源與服務。
option_explanations.C: 這比需求更寬鬆。
option_explanations.D: 加密不會限制可連線者。

questions.question_text: A legal team requires customer records to remain in one jurisdiction. Which data-control decision is FIRST?

options.A: Select storage and processing locations that satisfy sovereignty requirements
options.B: Choose the region with the cheapest storage only
options.C: Replicate records to every available region
options.D: Remove the retention policy

questions.explanation: Location controls address legal jurisdiction before deployment.

option_explanations.A: Location controls address legal jurisdiction before deployment.
option_explanations.B: Cost cannot override a legal location requirement.
option_explanations.C: Global replication may violate the requirement.
option_explanations.D: Retention does not select a lawful location.

zh-Hant.question_text: 法務要求客戶記錄留在單一司法管轄區。首先應做哪項資料控制決策？

options.A: 選擇符合 data sovereignty 的儲存與處理位置
options.B: 只選儲存最便宜的 region
options.C: 複製記錄到所有可用 region
options.D: 移除 retention policy

zh-Hant.explanation: 位置控制在部署前處理司法管轄。

option_explanations.A: 位置控制在部署前處理司法管轄。
option_explanations.B: 成本不能凌駕法律位置要求。
option_explanations.C: 全球複製可能違反要求。
option_explanations.D: 保留政策不會選擇合法位置。

questions.question_text: A service must resume within 30 minutes and may lose at most five minutes of transactions. Which architecture targets should be documented?

options.A: RPO of 30 minutes and RTO of five minutes
options.B: MTBF and asset value
options.C: SLE and ALE
options.D: RTO of 30 minutes and RPO of five minutes

questions.explanation: RTO limits restoration time; RPO limits data loss.

option_explanations.A: The two objectives are reversed.
option_explanations.B: These do not express recovery targets.
option_explanations.C: These are risk-loss metrics, not recovery objectives.
option_explanations.D: RTO limits restoration time; RPO limits data loss.

zh-Hant.question_text: 服務必須在 30 分鐘內復原，且最多遺失五分鐘交易。應記錄哪些架構目標？

options.A: RPO 30 分鐘與 RTO 五分鐘
options.B: MTBF 與資產價值
options.C: SLE 與 ALE
options.D: RTO 30 分鐘與 RPO 五分鐘

zh-Hant.explanation: RTO 限制復原時間；RPO 限制資料遺失。

option_explanations.A: 兩項目標順序相反。
option_explanations.B: 這些不表示復原目標。
option_explanations.C: 這些是風險損失指標，不是復原目標。
option_explanations.D: RTO 限制復原時間；RPO 限制資料遺失。

questions.question_text: A ransomware event destroys the primary site. Which TWO resilience choices most improve recovery confidence?

options.A: Keep the only backup writable on the primary host
options.B: Skip recovery testing to protect the backup
options.C: Maintain an isolated immutable backup
options.D: Exercise restoration against the documented RTO and RPO

questions.explanation: Isolation and immutability prevent tampering from production. Testing demonstrates that targets are achievable.

option_explanations.A: A primary compromise can destroy it.
option_explanations.B: Untested backups provide uncertain recovery.
option_explanations.C: Isolation and immutability prevent tampering from production.
option_explanations.D: Testing demonstrates that targets are achievable.

zh-Hant.question_text: 勒索軟體事件破壞主要站點。哪兩種韌性措施最能提高復原把握？選兩項。

options.A: 只在主站保留唯一可寫備份
options.B: 為保護備份而跳過復原測試
options.C: 維持隔離的 immutable backup
options.D: 依文件化 RTO 與 RPO 演練復原

zh-Hant.explanation: 隔離與不可變性可防止正式環境竄改。 測試可證明目標能達成。

option_explanations.A: 主站遭入侵時可一併破壞。
option_explanations.B: 未測試備份的復原能力不確定。
option_explanations.C: 隔離與不可變性可防止正式環境竄改。
option_explanations.D: 測試可證明目標能達成。

questions.question_text: An inventory shows an unowned cloud storage bucket containing regulated data. Which FIRST asset-management action is appropriate?

options.A: Ignore it until the next annual inventory
options.B: Assign an accountable owner and classify the data before changing access
options.C: Delete the bucket without preserving business context
options.D: Make the bucket public to find its owner

questions.explanation: Ownership and classification establish accountability and handling needs.

option_explanations.A: The regulated data is an immediate governance issue.
option_explanations.B: Ownership and classification establish accountability and handling needs.
option_explanations.C: Deletion may destroy required data and evidence.
option_explanations.D: Public exposure increases the incident.

zh-Hant.question_text: 清冊顯示一個無負責人的雲端儲存桶含受規範資料。首先應採取哪項資產管理行動？

options.A: 忽略直到下一年度清冊
options.B: 指定負責負責人並在修改存取前分類資料
options.C: 不保留業務情境就刪除儲存桶
options.D: 公開儲存桶以找出負責人

zh-Hant.explanation: 負責人與分類建立責任及處理需求。

option_explanations.A: 受規範資料是立即的治理問題。
option_explanations.B: 負責人與分類建立責任及處理需求。
option_explanations.C: 刪除可能破壞必要資料與證據。
option_explanations.D: 公開暴露會擴大事件。

questions.question_text: A risk register lists a high residual risk with no treatment owner. Which FIRST governance action is needed?

options.A: Assign an accountable owner and treatment decision
options.B: Remove the risk from the register
options.C: Set every risk to low
options.D: Wait for an incident before assigning responsibility

questions.explanation: Ownership makes treatment and acceptance accountable.

option_explanations.A: Ownership makes treatment and acceptance accountable.
option_explanations.B: Deletion hides rather than treats the risk.
option_explanations.C: Changing labels does not change exposure.
option_explanations.D: Governance should precede an incident.

zh-Hant.question_text: 風險登錄列出高 residual risk 卻沒有處理負責人。首先需要哪項治理行動？

options.A: 指定負責負責人與處理決策
options.B: 從登錄移除風險
options.C: 將所有風險設為 low
options.D: 等到事件後才分配責任

zh-Hant.explanation: 負責人使處理與接受決策具責任。

option_explanations.A: 負責人使處理與接受決策具責任。
option_explanations.B: 刪除只會隱藏而非處理風險。
option_explanations.C: 改標籤不會改變暴露。
option_explanations.D: 治理應在事件前完成。

questions.question_text: A vendor will process regulated data and subcontract hosting. The customer needs enforceable exit handling and notice of security incidents. Which TWO contract terms meet those needs? Select two.

options.A: Data return or secure deletion at contract exit
options.B: A service-credit schedule for availability failures only
options.C: An unlimited right to change scope without notice
options.D: A defined security-incident notification deadline and evidence obligation

questions.explanation: Exit terms reduce exposure after service termination. A defined notification term lets the customer coordinate response and meet its reporting requirements.

option_explanations.A: Exit terms reduce exposure after service termination.
option_explanations.B: Availability credits do not establish data handling at exit or a security-incident notification obligation.
option_explanations.C: Uncontrolled scope changes increase third-party risk.
option_explanations.D: A defined notification term lets the customer coordinate response and meet its reporting requirements.

zh-Hant.question_text: 供應商將處理受管制資料並分包託管；客戶需要可執行的退出資料處理與安全事件通知。哪兩種合約條款符合需要？選兩項。

options.A: 合約結束時返還或安全刪除資料
options.B: 僅針對可用性故障的服務抵扣表
options.C: 可不通知而無限變更範圍
options.D: 明定安全事件通知期限與證據義務

zh-Hant.explanation: 退出條款降低服務終止後的暴露。 明確通知條件讓客戶協調回應並履行通報要求。

option_explanations.A: 退出條款降低服務終止後的暴露。
option_explanations.B: 可用性抵扣不建立退出資料處理或安全事件通知義務。
option_explanations.C: 不受控範圍變更會增加第三方風險。
option_explanations.D: 明確通知條件讓客戶協調回應並履行通報要求。

questions.question_text: An auditor asks why a retention exception preserved investigation data. Which TWO records best support the decision?

options.A: An unrelated application-performance report
options.B: A user’s informal chat with no approval
options.C: The approved legal hold and responsible owner
options.D: The retention rule and documented exception reason

questions.explanation: The hold and owner show authority, scope, and accountability. The rule and exception explain why routine deletion was suspended.

option_explanations.A: Performance data does not establish authority to suspend disposal of investigation records.
option_explanations.B: An informal message lacks authoritative approval.
option_explanations.C: The hold and owner show authority, scope, and accountability.
option_explanations.D: The rule and exception explain why routine deletion was suspended.

zh-Hant.question_text: 稽核員要求說明為何保存期限例外保留調查資料。哪兩種紀錄最能支持此決策？選兩項。

options.A: 無關應用程式效能報告
options.B: 沒有核准的使用者閒聊
options.C: 核准的 legal hold 與負責負責人
options.D: retention 規則與文件化例外理由

zh-Hant.explanation: legal hold 與負責人呈現授權、範圍與責任。 規則與例外說明為何暫停正常刪除。

option_explanations.A: 效能資料不建立暫停處置調查紀錄的權限。
option_explanations.B: 非正式訊息缺乏權威核准。
option_explanations.C: legal hold 與負責人呈現授權、範圍與責任。
option_explanations.D: 規則與例外說明為何暫停正常刪除。

questions.question_text: A security team compares two audits: one tests control design at a point in time, and one tests operating effectiveness over six months. Which distinction is correct?

options.A: Neither can produce evidence for customers
options.B: The second provides period evidence of operating effectiveness
options.C: The first proves every future control operation
options.D: Both are identical because all audits have the same scope

questions.explanation: Testing over six months evaluates whether controls operated consistently.

option_explanations.A: Independent reports can provide customer assurance.
option_explanations.B: Testing over six months evaluates whether controls operated consistently.
option_explanations.C: A point-in-time test cannot prove future performance.
option_explanations.D: Audit scope and period can differ materially.

zh-Hant.question_text: 安全團隊比較兩次稽核：一次測試單一時間點的控制設計，一次測試六個月的運作有效性。哪項區分正確？

options.A: 兩者都不能提供客戶證據
options.B: 第二次提供期間內運作有效性的證據
options.C: 第一次證明未來每次控制運作
options.D: 兩者相同，因為所有稽核範圍都相同

zh-Hant.explanation: 六個月測試評估控制是否持續運作。

option_explanations.A: 獨立報告可提供客戶保證。
option_explanations.B: 六個月測試評估控制是否持續運作。
option_explanations.C: 單一時間點無法證明未來表現。
option_explanations.D: 稽核範圍與期間可有重大差異。

questions.question_text: A phishing exercise shows fewer clicks but more reports than the previous quarter. What is the best interpretation?

options.A: Recognition and reporting behavior improved
options.B: Training failed because completion rate was not measured
options.C: The exercise proves no real phishing can succeed
options.D: More reports always mean more false positives

questions.explanation: The behavior metrics show better resistance and escalation.

option_explanations.A: The behavior metrics show better resistance and escalation.
option_explanations.B: Completion is less direct than behavior for this question.
option_explanations.C: A simulation cannot prove future immunity.
option_explanations.D: Reporting volume alone does not establish false positives.

zh-Hant.question_text: 釣魚演練顯示點擊比上一季少、通報比上一季多。最佳解讀是什麼？

options.A: 辨識與通報行為改善
options.B: 因未量課程完成率所以訓練失敗
options.C: 演練證明真實 phishing 不可能成功
options.D: 更多通報必然代表更多 false positive

zh-Hant.explanation: 行為指標顯示抵抗與升級通報改善。

option_explanations.A: 行為指標顯示抵抗與升級通報改善。
option_explanations.B: 對本題而言完成率不如行為直接。
option_explanations.C: 演練不能證明未來絕對免疫。
option_explanations.D: 通報量本身不能證明 false positive。

questions.question_text: A board-approved security policy assigns the CISO authority to approve exceptions. Which governance principle is demonstrated?

options.A: Uncontrolled risk acceptance by every user
options.B: Permanent policy immutability
options.C: A technical firewall rule
options.D: Defined accountability and delegated authority

questions.explanation: The policy identifies who may make and own the decision.

option_explanations.A: Risk acceptance should belong to accountable roles.
option_explanations.B: Governance policies require review as risk changes.
option_explanations.C: A firewall rule does not establish governance authority.
option_explanations.D: The policy identifies who may make and own the decision.

zh-Hant.question_text: 董事會核准的安全政策授予 CISO 核准例外的權限。這展現哪項治理原則？

options.A: 每位使用者不受控地接受風險
options.B: 政策永久不可變更
options.C: 技術防火牆規則
options.D: 明確責任與授權

zh-Hant.explanation: 政策指出誰可作決策並承擔責任。

option_explanations.A: 風險接受應屬負責角色。
option_explanations.B: 治理政策需隨風險變化審查。
option_explanations.C: 防火牆規則不會建立治理權限。
option_explanations.D: 政策指出誰可作決策並承擔責任。
